rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who gets angry easily or often.

example.english: They are bad-tempered; whenever things do not go their way, they lose their temper.
example.traditional: 佢好易嬲㗎，一唔順心就發脾氣。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hou2 ji6 nau1 gaa3 jat1 m4 seon6 sam1 zau6 faat3 pei4 hei3

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that someone has a consistently unpleasant or bad temper.

example.english: They are bad-tempered and are always picking fights with people.
example.traditional: 佢脾氣臭到不得了，成日同人鬧交。
example.jyutping: keoi5 pei4 hei3 cau3 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5 seng4 jat6 tung4 jan4 naau6 gaau1

rows.note: Use this colloquial expression for someone who is characteristically short-tempered or quick to flare up.

example.english: Ming is bad-tempered and blows up over the slightest thing.
example.traditional: 阿明好燥底，少少事都會發火。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 hou2 cou3 dai2 siu2 siu2 si6 dou1 wui5 faat3 fo2
